title: Aliens on time travel and wormholes

tellings.quote: They said that um that they have time travel. They don't like to use it very much because um and especially don't like to do long jumps

plain: The aliens he met aboard a craft over Fillmore, California told him they can travel in time, says Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies what he believes are alien implants in human bodies. He tells Michels they "don't like to use it very much," and especially avoid long jumps, and the story also takes in wormholes, shortcuts through space and time. If true, the visitors would have time travel and hold back from using it.
